presets.title: Starter Scheduled Tasks
presets.description: Turn on high-value automations out of the box. You can still refine them later or ask the Agent to customize them.
presets.directCreateHint: These presets will be bound directly to the current conversation. If you want to tweak the timing or wording first, fill the prompt into chat and let the Agent adjust it.

presets.emptyHint: Preset timers must be attached to a specific conversation. Open a single-agent conversation, then click the clock button in the top-right corner to enable one.

all.title: All Industry Packs
all.description: Browse the full starter library across product, growth, recruiting, sales, and research workflows.
all.bestFor: Teams still exploring where scheduled automations create the most leverage.
all.outcome: Compare multiple operating styles first, then narrow into a focused pack once one workflow stands out.

saasProduct.description: Built for product-led SaaS teams that need recurring visibility into user behavior, backlog pressure, competitor moves, and weekly execution rhythm.
saasProduct.bestFor: Product managers, product ops, and startup teams that want one strong default pack before specializing.
saasProduct.outcome: Catch usage shifts earlier, keep priorities current, and maintain a steady decision cadence without rebuilding the workflow every week.

contentGrowth.description: Built for content and growth teams that need repeatable topic discovery, calendar checks, experiment reviews, and audience-signal monitoring.
contentGrowth.bestFor: Content leads, growth marketers, and lean teams running organic distribution with limited bandwidth.
contentGrowth.outcome: Keep the pipeline warm, reduce topic gaps, and turn scattered growth work into a repeatable publishing and review loop.

recruitingOps.description: Built for recruiting workflows that need daily pipeline visibility, interview-feedback rollups, and operational follow-through across open roles.
recruitingOps.bestFor: Recruiters, hiring managers, and recruiting coordinators handling multiple candidates and parallel stages.
recruitingOps.outcome: Spot bottlenecks faster, push stalled candidates forward, and make hiring decisions with cleaner daily summaries.

salesFollowUp.description: Built for sales follow-up work that depends on rapid response, stale-opportunity detection, and consistent deal review across the funnel.
salesFollowUp.bestFor: Sales reps, founders doing outbound, and revenue teams that cannot afford follow-up drift.
salesFollowUp.outcome: Recover stalled deals sooner, maintain follow-up cadence, and surface the next best move before pipeline quality drops.

researchMonitoring.description: Built for research-heavy workflows that rely on fresh policy signals, market movement, competitor tracking, and structured weekly synthesis.
researchMonitoring.bestFor: Analysts, investors, strategy teams, and operators tracking moving markets or regulated sectors.
researchMonitoring.outcome: Reduce signal lag, keep monitoring consistent, and turn fragmented updates into a sharper research decision loop.

aiDigest.name: AI News Digest
aiDigest.description: Track the latest AI models, products, and market signals every workday and turn them into an actionable brief.
aiDigest.message: Track the most important AI model, product, funding, policy, or industry updates from the last 24 hours. Summarize the top 5 signals and explain the impact, risks, and recommended actions for each.

competitorWatch.name: Competitor Watch
competitorWatch.description: Review product moves, pricing changes, launches, and messaging shifts from key competitors every afternoon.
competitorWatch.message: Track whether our key competitors made any notable product launches, feature updates, pricing changes, channel moves, or reputation shifts today. Summarize the implications and recommend what we should respond to.

morningFocus.name: Morning Focus Plan
morningFocus.description: Use the current conversation context to decide what matters most today and what should happen first.
morningFocus.message: Based on this conversation and its existing context, identify today's top 3 priorities, likely blockers, the recommended execution order, and the most valuable first-hour action to start with.

contentRadar.name: Content Idea Radar
contentRadar.description: Generate timely topics worth writing, posting, or amplifying twice a week for content and growth work.
contentRadar.message: Using the direction of this conversation, generate 5 timely content ideas or distribution angles. For each one, explain the target audience, key point of view, suggested headline direction, and the best channels to publish in.

saasUsageReview.name: Active User Shift Review
saasUsageReview.description: Review active-user movement, usage frequency, and behavior signals every morning so product and ops teams can catch anomalies early.
saasUsageReview.message: Using the product goals and user context in this conversation, review recent active-user changes, unusual usage-frequency shifts, feature adoption drift, and potential churn signals. Explain the most important causes to investigate and the next actions to take.

backlogPrioritization.name: Backlog Priority Review
backlogPrioritization.description: Re-check the product backlog twice a week so product teams can re-rank work and spot high-risk requests in time.
backlogPrioritization.message: Based on the requests, issues, goals, and feedback in this conversation, reassess backlog priority. List what should move up, what can wait, which items are risky, and the reasoning behind the recommended order.

contentCalendar.name: Content Calendar Review
contentCalendar.description: Review upcoming publishing plans several times a week to keep topic coverage and channel timing on track.
contentCalendar.scheduleDescription: Every Monday, Wednesday, and Friday at 10:00
contentCalendar.message: Review the content plan and distribution goals in this conversation. Suggest a short-term publishing calendar, highlight topic gaps, channel timing problems, the most urgent items to fill, and the themes worth pushing harder.

growthExperimentReview.name: Growth Experiment Review
growthExperimentReview.description: Review growth experiments mid-week to surface what is working, what is drifting, and what should be tested next.
growthExperimentReview.message: Review the growth experiments or distribution actions currently in progress. Summarize the best-performing attempts, unusual changes, likely causes, hypotheses still worth testing, and the next experiment with the highest value.

candidatePipelineReview.name: Candidate Pipeline Review
candidatePipelineReview.description: Review stage distribution, blockers, and priority candidates every workday for recruiting operations.
candidatePipelineReview.message: Using the hiring roles, candidates, and process context in this conversation, build a candidate pipeline review. List stage counts, blockers, the candidates who need action now, and the recruiting moves that matter most today.

interviewFeedbackDigest.name: Interview Feedback Digest
interviewFeedbackDigest.description: Summarize interview feedback every evening so recruiting teams can quickly spot strengths, risks, and next-step decisions.
interviewFeedbackDigest.message: Summarize today's interview feedback. Extract candidate strengths, risks, open questions, and whether each candidate should move forward, and present it in a format that helps the hiring team decide quickly.

staleDealAlert.name: Stale Deal Alert
staleDealAlert.description: Identify stalled opportunities every afternoon so the sales team can recover follow-up momentum before deals go cold.
staleDealAlert.message: Identify stale deals or customers that have not moved for too long in this conversation. Explain why they may be stalled, the deal risk, the best reactivation approach, and the follow-up action that should be sent today.

policySignalWatch.name: Policy Signal Watch
policySignalWatch.description: Track policy, regulatory, and official-industry signals every workday morning for research-heavy workflows.
policySignalWatch.message: Track policy, regulatory, industry-guidance, or official statements from the last 24 hours that are relevant to the research theme in this conversation. Extract the most important signals and explain their impact on judgment, risk, and what to study next.

endOfDayReview.name: End-of-Day Review
endOfDayReview.description: Wrap up each workday with a concise progress summary, carry-over items, and tomorrow's handoff list.
endOfDayReview.message: Review today's progress: summarize what was completed, what is still pending, the main risks, and what should be carried into tomorrow. End with a clear handoff checklist for the next workday.

userFeedbackDigest.name: User Feedback Digest
userFeedbackDigest.description: Turn daily feedback into a clear digest of repeated issues, sentiment trends, and what needs attention first.
userFeedbackDigest.message: Summarize today's user feedback, requests, complaints, or questions. Extract repeated themes, user sentiment, emerging risks, and the top 3 issues we should address first.

weeklyReview.name: Friday Weekly Report
weeklyReview.description: Generate a structured weekly recap every Friday to review wins, risks, and the next week's priorities.
weeklyReview.message: Prepare a structured weekly report with key outcomes, unresolved items, risk alerts, decisions that still need to be made, and the top 3 priorities for next week.

leadFollowUp.name: Lead Follow-Up Queue
leadFollowUp.description: Turn sales and partnership context into a prioritized queue of who to follow up with and what to do next.
leadFollowUp.message: Based on the sales leads, customer outreach, or partnership context in this conversation, list the opportunities that need follow-up today, their current status, the key risks, the suggested response angle, and the next action to move each one forward.
